name: Farmapram Alprazolam 2mg — 90 Tablets
short: Farmapram® alprazolam 2 mg, 90 tablets — Mexican brand benzodiazepine indicated for anxiety and panic disorder. Available with prescription verification at CMC Pharmacy Cabo.
description:
Farmapram® is the Mexican brand of alprazolam 2 mg, a benzodiazepine indicated for generalized anxiety disorder and panic disorder with or without agoraphobia. Each tablet contains 2 mg of alprazolam, and this commercial presentation includes 90 tablets manufactured under Mexican pharmaceutical regulations.

Alprazolam acts on the central nervous system to produce a calming effect by enhancing the activity of a natural inhibitory neurotransmitter (GABA). It is typically prescribed for short- to medium-term symptom relief. Dosing should always be individualized by your prescribing physician; never adjust the dose on your own. Consult your healthcare provider before starting, modifying, or discontinuing this medication.

Available at CMC Pharmacy Cabo with bilingual service and fast hotel delivery throughout Cabo San Lucas, San José del Cabo, and the tourist corridor. Prescription Required. A valid medical prescription is needed to dispense this medication. CMC Pharmacy Cabo verifies prescriptions per Mexican regulations (NOM-073-SSA1).
